answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the haven queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The orchard index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 582 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the prism. Each impostor pays 17 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
